label: Applying to a Singapore private institution or foreign branch campus, 2027

milestones.label: IB results released
milestones.note: These institutions mostly run trimesters with several intakes a year rather than one August start, so results landing in July are less of a cliff here than at an autonomous university. That is a statement about the structure and not about any deadline, because none is published.

submissionItems.label: Check the institution's Private Education Institution registration and its expiry
submissionItems.destinationOfItem: The institution's own page, where the registration number and period are published.
submissionItems.note: Singapore registers private education institutions for a fixed term rather than chartering them indefinitely, and the expiry date is public — Curtin Singapore's runs 20 May 2026 to 19 May 2032. A registration expiring inside the length of your degree is a question to ask before enrolling.

supplementarySteps: Establish who awards the degree before anything else. Curtin Singapore and James Cook University Singapore award Australian degrees, DigiPen Singapore an American one, ESSEC Asia-Pacific a French one, and SIM Global Education delivers several partner universities' degrees without awarding any of its own.

Assume the MOE Tuition Grant does not apply. It is a subsidy to Singapore's own institutions, and none of these is an Autonomous University — which also means no service obligation, no sureties and no bond.
Ask each institution directly for its deadlines. None of them publishes one for 2027 on the pages consulted here.
For ESSEC's Global BBA, the application is made to ESSEC in France on the French cycle, not to the Singapore campus.

notes: Five institutions, no dates. This is the least-researched route in this Destination and the record says so rather than implying these institutions admit continuously. James Cook University Singapore's pages refused automated retrieval; Curtin, DigiPen, SIM and ESSEC publish no undergraduate application deadline on the pages consulted.

Not established: whether the MOE Tuition Grant reaches any of these institutions. The assumption recorded above — that it does not, because they are not Autonomous Universities — is stated as an assumption in the step rather than as a finding, and should be confirmed with the institution.
"Apply directly" here is a researched finding rather than a placeholder: none of these institutions sits in a shared admissions system, and each runs its own form on its own calendar.
